# tidyna

Tired of littering your code with `na.rm = TRUE`?

**`tidyna`** masks common R functions and warns you when NAs are
removed. It handles some special cases. The
[`table()`](https://statzhero.github.io/tidyna/reference/table-functions.md)
default is set to `useNA = "ifany"`.

## Installation

Install from CRAN:

``` r

install.packages("tidyna")
```

Or install the development version from GitHub:

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("statzhero/tidyna")
```

## Usage

``` r

library(tidyna)

x <- c(1, 2, NA)
mean(x)
#> ⚠️ 1 missing value removed.
#> [1] 1.5
```

Suppress warnings with `options(tidyna.warn = FALSE)`.

## Functions

- **Summary**: `mean`, `weighted.mean`, `sum`, `prod`, `sd`, `var`,
  `median`, `quantile`
- **Extrema**: `min`, `max`, `pmin`, `pmax`, `range`
- **Logical**: `any`, `all`
- **Row-wise**: `rowSums`, `rowMeans`
- **Correlation**: `cor`
- **Table**: `table`

## Special cases

**All-NA input is configurable**: By default, tidyna throws an error
when all values are NA to prevent misleading values like `Inf`, `NaN`,
or `0`:

``` r

base::sum(c(NA, NA), na.rm = TRUE)
#> [1] 0

sum(c(NA, NA))
#> Error in `sum()`:
#> ! All values are NA; check if something went wrong.
```

You can change this behavior with the `all_na` argument or the
`tidyna.all_na` option:

``` r

# Return base R behavior (NaN, Inf, 0, etc.)
sum(c(NA, NA), all_na = "base")
#> [1] 0

# Always return NA
sum(c(NA, NA), all_na = "na")
#> [1] NA
```

**`rowSums`/`rowMeans`** return `NA` for all-NA rows, but error if the
entire matrix is NA. Also configurable via `all_na`.

**`pmax`/`pmin`** return `NA` for positions where all inputs are NA
(with a warning), but error if every position is all-NA. Also
configurable via `all_na`.

**`cor`** defaults to `use = "pairwise.complete.obs"` instead of
erroring on NAs.

**`table`** defaults to `useNA = "ifany"`, showing NA counts when
present rather than silently dropping them.

## Performance

There is no free lunch. The `tidyna` package adds some overhead:

![](reference/figures/overhead.png)

For most functions like
[`mean()`](https://statzhero.github.io/tidyna/reference/summary-functions.md)
the overhead is negligible (1.1x). But
[`rowMeans()`](https://statzhero.github.io/tidyna/reference/row-functions.md)
and
[`rowSums()`](https://statzhero.github.io/tidyna/reference/row-functions.md)
require an extra pass to detect all-NA rows, so there is a substantial
loss (3-4x).

I’m still working on whether the memory allocation needs to be
addressed.

## Roadmap

- Add explicit `_aware` suffixed versions (`mean_aware`, `sum_aware`,
  etc.) for users who prefer not to mask base functions.

## Related packages

- [naflex](https://cran.r-project.org/package=naflex): Conditional NA
  removal based on thresholds
- [na.tools](https://cran.r-project.org/package=na.tools): Utilities for
  working with missing values

# Package index

## Summary statistics

NA-aware replacements for common summary functions.

- [`mean()`](https://statzhero.github.io/tidyna/reference/summary-functions.md)
  [`sum()`](https://statzhero.github.io/tidyna/reference/summary-functions.md)
  [`prod()`](https://statzhero.github.io/tidyna/reference/summary-functions.md)
  [`sd()`](https://statzhero.github.io/tidyna/reference/summary-functions.md)
  [`var()`](https://statzhero.github.io/tidyna/reference/summary-functions.md)
  [`median()`](https://statzhero.github.io/tidyna/reference/summary-functions.md)
  [`quantile()`](https://statzhero.github.io/tidyna/reference/summary-functions.md)
  : NA-aware Summary Functions
- [`weighted.mean()`](https://statzhero.github.io/tidyna/reference/weighted.mean.md)
  : NA-aware weighted mean

## Extrema

NA-aware replacements for min, max, and range functions.

- [`min()`](https://statzhero.github.io/tidyna/reference/extrema-functions.md)
  [`max()`](https://statzhero.github.io/tidyna/reference/extrema-functions.md)
  [`range()`](https://statzhero.github.io/tidyna/reference/extrema-functions.md)
  [`pmax()`](https://statzhero.github.io/tidyna/reference/extrema-functions.md)
  [`pmin()`](https://statzhero.github.io/tidyna/reference/extrema-functions.md)
  : NA-aware Extrema Functions

## Logical

NA-aware replacements for logical aggregation.

- [`any()`](https://statzhero.github.io/tidyna/reference/logical-functions.md)
  [`all()`](https://statzhero.github.io/tidyna/reference/logical-functions.md)
  : NA-aware Logical Functions

## Row-wise

NA-aware row-wise operations.

- [`rowMeans()`](https://statzhero.github.io/tidyna/reference/row-functions.md)
  [`rowSums()`](https://statzhero.github.io/tidyna/reference/row-functions.md)
  : NA-aware Row-wise Functions

## Correlation

NA-aware correlation with pairwise complete observations.

- [`cor()`](https://statzhero.github.io/tidyna/reference/correlation-functions.md)
  : NA-aware Correlation Function

## Table

Table with NA counts shown by default.

- [`table()`](https://statzhero.github.io/tidyna/reference/table-functions.md)
  : NA-aware Table Function
